question: How is the god of gods, supreme in discerning being and non-being, honored with new praises?
premises: The god of gods possesses supreme power to discern being and non-being.
New praises are the means of honoring.
inference: The supreme deity, master of discerning being and non-being, is rightly honored with fresh praises.
plain_english: With new praises, to the god of gods, whose supreme power discerns being and non-being.
